question: How many port calls will IMF PortWatch record at Ukraine's three main Black Sea ports over the latest reported week as of October 1, 2026?

calls.reasoning: The resolution instrument, not the war, dominates. PortWatch's own feed shows combined Odessa+Chornomorsk+Pivdennyi portcalls collapsing from ~210-264/month (Jan-Sep 2024) to 71 in Oct 2024 and then 0-4/month continuously through Sep 2026 - 9 calls in all of 2025 and 9 in 2026 to date - because corridor vessels sail AIS-dark and the region is jammed. The HDX Ukraine CSV is a straight slice of that same feed (same port IDs, latest row 2026-09-11, all three ports zero). Reference-class prior: 0.21 calls per 7-day window, ~80% of weeks at zero. The current regime pushes lower still: 49 consecutive zero days (25 Jul - 11 Sep) and independent reporting that no ships entered Greater Odesa in September. Upside routes are (a) one stray AIS-visible call, ~9%, and (b) a PortWatch methodology fix/backfill or a ceasefire restoring both sailings and AIS inside the ~19-25 Sep window, which is very unlikely in 10 days and would anyway reveal a heavily suppressed week. If no update lands before 1 Oct, the fallback window (5-11 Sep) is already known to be 0.

disagreements.verdict: All runs agree: Tuesday refreshes on 22 and 29 Sep at a ~4-5 day lag make 2026-09-19 to 09-25 most likely, with 09-12 to 09-18 or the published 09-05 to 09-11 as fallbacks. All three windows lie inside the standstill and the fallback is already known to be 0, so the ambiguity does not move the estimate.

disagreements.claim: How far below the 0.20/week base rate the post-22-July-2026 regime sits.
disagreements.verdict: No evidence breaks the tie - 7 post-escalation windows at zero is too small a sample to pin lambda. I take ~0.10-0.12, halfway between the unconditional base rate and the zero-observed conditional, giving P(0)=0.89.

disagreements.claim: Whether any market prices this quantity.
disagreements.verdict: Confirmed none found - all three runs checked Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi and bookmakers independently, as did the harness title search. No crowd anchor exists.
